description: This file implements the RunC container management class, including container lifecycle operations (create, start, stop, delete), state retrieval, and configuration handling, utilizing the runc CLI tool within the WPEFramework namespace.

classes.name: Runner
classes.description: Encapsulates runc CLI interactions for container lifecycle management, including create, execute, delete, and state retrieval, with configuration and environment inheritance.

classes.name: Runner::Info
classes.description: Represents container state information such as PID and status, parsed from runc's state output.

classes.name: Runner::Config
classes.description: Represents container configuration, including environment variables, loaded from config.json.

classes.name: Runner::Config::ProcessData
classes.description: Holds process-specific configuration data, notably environment variables.

classes.name: RunCContainer
classes.description: Represents a container instance managed via runc, providing lifecycle control and status queries.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new container with specified ID and bundle path using runc.

methods.name: Exec
methods.description: Executes a command inside the container, optionally with parameters.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the container.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists all containers managed by runc.

methods.name: InheritHostEnvironmentVariables
methods.description: Inherits environment variables from host as specified in the container's config.json.

methods.name: InternalPurge
methods.description: Stops and removes the container if it is running.
